title: City of Vernon 2025 SOFI: complete named employee remuneration and expenses
notes: Every published name, title where present, separate remuneration and expense cell was checked on actual PDF-painted source images; independent Tesseract and Paddle OCR outputs and their source-reviewed corrections remain separate.
An independent peer transcribed the complete source-image scope before full candidate comparison. Prior context disclosures and reviewer-only rereads remain in the immutable peer receipts.
Repeated names or initials remain distinct literal observations; no identity merging, full-name enrichment, annualization or redistribution of aggregate amounts.
The separate source expense-inclusive Total column, when printed, is retained only in supporting evidence and is never substituted for remuneration.
Printed schedule year and signed approval are independently recorded; URL/upload dates are not used as reporting-year evidence.
The official index links the corrected signed original. The cover labels SOFI unaudited; the signed approval page approves the statements and schedules. No audited-compensation claim is made.

definitions.remuneration: Employee column: 2025 Gross Earnings. Council column: 2025 Remuneration.
definitions.expenses: Employee column: Expenses (Net of Tax). Council column: Expenses.
definitions.financialStatementRelation: Total gross earnings differ from total wages included in the City's Consolidated Statement of Operations due to the employer portion of benefit costs.

publicWarning: The 264 named employee rows total CAD 28,678,528 gross earnings and 380,683 expenses net of tax. Gross earnings agree with the printed named subtotal; the printed named-expense subtotal is 381,690, so literal row expenses minus that control are -1,007. Printed named expenses 381,690 plus below-threshold expenses 100,126 equal the printed all-employee expense total 481,816. Individual cells remain as printed, without balancing or a cause inferred. All 25 literal zero expenses remain 0. Employee job titles are not published and remain null. Retain the compiled partition: no compatible same-calendar-year compiled cohort has been established. Root owns any future period mapping or deletion; full strict multiset comparison is pinned separately.
